card.title: IPhone XS Not Powering On, Pulls 2A or More Before Promt to Boot

source.title: IPhone XS Not Powering On, Pulls 2A or More Before Promt to Boot

claims.statement: iPhone XS drawing 2 A+ before power-on: shorted cap on PP_VDD_MAIN or PP_VDD_BOOST, or rarely speaker amp U4902/U5002; split to find which board holds the short.
Yangtze heats when injecting via the battery connector; usually not the fault.

procedure: Inject 4 V / 2 A; remove hot cap or replace amp.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
